visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing a white T-shirt and light blue flared jeans, stands next to a lime-green train car marked with the brand name "Shanlan". A male conductor in a dark uniform and cap smiles brightly from a square window, looking directly at the camera. The setting is an outdoor train platform under bright natural daylight, with the train's smooth metallic side reflecting the light. (2) Inside a train station with high arched ceilings and wooden beams, four women, including the main protagonist, stand in a row smiling. They hold up small green rectangular tickets or travel cards toward the lens. Above them, a digital sign displays "Chishang Platform 1" and various train departure times. The lighting is a mix of bright indoor lamps and ambient daylight. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a modern sightseeing train featuring lime-green plush armchairs and light-colored wood tables. Three women are seated in the lounge area, smiling and posing for the camera. The main character in the foreground rests her face in her hands while seated. Outside the large panoramic windows, blurred green trees and countryside landscapes rush past. (4) The main character is shown sitting alone on a green circular stool next to a large train window, looking out thoughtfully at the passing scenery of lush green vegetation and distant mountains. She wears a colorful beaded lanyard around her neck with a cross pendant. The interior is well-lit and clean, emphasizing a comfortable travel experience. (5) The woman poses outdoors next to a large, unique sculpture of a snail constructed from red-brown bricks, resting on a tiered black pedestal. Behind her, several cars are parked near trees under an overcast sky. A yellow frame overlay on the screen contains the text "Shanlan" and references "Fenglin", indicating a stop on her journey. (6) A close-up shot captures the woman smiling broadly inside the train cabin. She holds a large, two-compartment wooden bento box showcasing a variety of colorful foods, including rice, green broccoli, purple cauliflower, meat, and a wrapped zongzi-like item. A pink circular sticker with the "Shanlan" logo is visible on her white T-shirt. (7) The woman stands on a scenic overlook or bridge with a grey metal railing. Behind her is a breathtaking view of vast yellow and green rice fields that stretch across a wide valley toward high, jagged mountains partially covered by low-hanging clouds. The sky is grey and overcast, casting a soft, diffuse light over the rural landscape. (8) A wide, panning shot of the expansive Chishang rice paddies. The fields are divided into neat geometric plots of vibrant green and harvest-ready golden yellow. A single power line pole stands in the distance against a backdrop of dark, forested mountains and a heavy, cloudy sky. The overall atmosphere is serene and natural. (9) Returning to the train platform, the woman stands once more in front of the lime-green "Shanlan" train car. She raises her left arm high in the air with a closed fist in a joyful and energetic pose, smiling at the viewer. The lighting remains bright and natural, concluding the visual montage of her travel adventure.
